structures.label: Cerebrum
structures.function: Largest brain region supporting sensory, motor, language, memory, emotion, and cognition.

structures.label: Frontal lobe
structures.function: Supports executive functions, voluntary motor control, and aspects of language.

structures.label: Temporal lobe
structures.function: Supports hearing, memory, and language comprehension.

structures.label: Occipital lobe
structures.function: Contains major cortical regions for visual processing.

structures.label: Corpus callosum
structures.function: Major white-matter tract connecting the cerebral hemispheres.

structures.label: Thalamus
structures.function: Relays and integrates many sensory and motor signals with the cerebral cortex.

structures.label: Hypothalamus
structures.function: Coordinates autonomic and endocrine functions that support homeostasis.

structures.label: Pituitary gland
structures.function: Endocrine gland regulated closely by the hypothalamus.

structures.label: Midbrain
structures.function: Superior portion of the brainstem involved in motor and sensory pathways.

structures.label: Pons
structures.function: Brainstem region connecting major neural pathways and contributing to respiratory and sleep functions.

structures.label: Medulla oblongata
structures.function: Inferior brainstem region continuous with the spinal cord and involved in vital autonomic control.

structures.label: Cerebellum
structures.function: Coordinates movement, balance, posture, muscle tone, and motor learning.

structures.label: Spinal cord
structures.function: Carries neural signals between the brain and the body.
